card_text: [Main] If your Leader is [Uta], look at 3 cards from the top of your deck, reveal up to 1 [FILM] type card other than [New Genesis] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order and set up to 1 of your DON!! cards as active.
